ns0:svg.data-production-method: Native outlined type, frame contours, icons, counters and rarity stars; retained artwork, brush materials and logo masks.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Blue Gambit

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
Use when entering Combat. Reveal your hand.
If it has at least 3 Blue Style cards,
attach this to your Main Personality.
While attached, you may play Allies up to 2
personality levels above your Main Personality.
